findings.finding: Same bounded bytes are SHA checked then parsed; canonical paths, regular file/euid, no group/world write, capsule0600, O_RDONLY/O_NOFOLLOW and before/after identity checks; all source hashes/inodes checked again at end. EINTR read produces a safe refusal, not a write.

Pinned capture/report/config/stop/domain references are cross-bound; independent core witness canonical current intent links next to primary and previous+1 sequence. Key indices/pubkeys/primary stop aliases are re-linked, without reopening or independently redecoding the 32 journal snapshots/intents.

Expected request SHA is externally required. System wall time is genuinely sampled and target as-of must be fresh <=5 seconds before projection. Actual64 registry/domain/network identity decoded from bound snapshot with qualified C++ core; exact runtime limits and unchanged finite2h/60step/120000ms policy enforced.

Uses CapellaSlotPreparation on an authenticated parent, bounded64 slot chunks and100000 sync trials, epoch-boundary vote_context telemetry, then pure proposer_identity. No durable reactor, clock publication, signer, journal, database, network or runtime constructor/callback.
Linux-only st_mtim/st_ctim and ru_maxrss KiB confirmed by author; no Mac-native portability claim.60s/128MiB are cooperative observation/refusal budgets, not universal OS-enforced ceilings.

limitations: Authority is the caller independently supplying the exact request SHA; the helper does not authenticate an arbitrary self-consistent user request against a global authority.
Availability is projected at actualWallObservedMs, not guaranteed at the later completion/current instant.
Real startup catch-up, its publications, finite-step elapsed time and duty/network scheduling are not exercised.
Source journals and anti-double-signature floors reuse prior capture718 hash-pinned provenance; no new physical audit.
Sync membership/aggregate bytes are observed, aggregate signature/BLS semantics are not newly qualified.
Passing this helper does not authorize signatures, restoration signing, recovery, consensus liveness or production readiness.
